{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the QA test orders
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA test orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")

# Check the revenue column type and sample
print(f"Revenue dtype: {sales['revenue'].dtype}")
print(f"Sample of revenue: {sales['revenue'].head(5).tolist()}")

# Check for -1 in customer_age
print(f"Number of -1 in customer_age: {(sales['customer_age'] == -1).sum()}")"}
